chunks: Muhammad ibn Ali Majiluyah (may God be pleased with him) narrated to us, saying: Muhammad ibn Yahya al-Attar narrated to us, saying: He narrated to me Abu Sa'id al-Adamy, saying: He narrated to me Al-Hasan ibn al-Hussein al-Lu'lu'i, from Muhammad ibn Sa'id ibn Ghazwan, from Isma'il ibn Abi Ziyad, from Abu Abdillah Ja'far ibn Muhammad, from his father, from his grandfather, from his father, peace be upon them.
The Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) said: Prolonged sitting in the toilet causes hemorrhoids.

key_terms.الْخَلَاءِ: The toilet or place of relieving oneself

ai.seo_question: What is the cause of hemorrhoids according to Imam Ali (AS)?
ai.summary: This hadith from Shaykh al-Saduq’s *Al-Khisal* highlights the practical medical wisdom of Imam Ali (AS), linking prolonged sitting in the toilet to the development of hemorrhoids (al-basur). It reflects the Shia tradition of integrating bodily hygiene with spiritual discipline, emphasizing that physical ailments often stem from neglecting natural bodily functions. The teaching underscores the holistic view of health in Islamic tradition, where physical well-being is seen as integral to overall piety and self-care.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 1-65 Muhammad ibn Ali Majiluyih - may God be pleased with him - narrated that Muhammad ibn Yahya al-Attar quoted on the authority of Abu Sa’id al-Adamy, on the authority of Al-Hassan ibn al-Hussein al-Lu’lu’ee, on the authority of Muhammad ibn Sa’id ibn Qazvan, on the authorityof Isma’il ibn Abi Zyad, on the authority of Aba Abdullah - Ja’far ibn Muhammad as-Sadiq (as), on the authority of his father, on the authority of his grandfather, on the authority of his father (as) that the Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali (as) said, “Sitting on the toilet for too long will lead to hemorrhoids.”
